bull_argument.argument:
Sime combines 9.81x trailing earnings and positive free cash flow with reported FY26 core profit growth of 32.6% to RM1.55bn and a 14-sen annual dividend. Core growth offers a stronger basis than extrapolating reported profit distorted by prior disposal gains.

The longer uptrend remains intact even as momentum cools, making consolidation a plausible accumulation opportunity. Thin automotive margins and the higher forward multiple deserve diligence, but operating cash generation and core growth support a credible value-and-income proposition. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
The 9.81x trailing multiple and cash generation are attractive starting points, but 3.26% operating margin leaves little room for automotive-cycle pressure. Forward P/E at 10.67x and disposal effects require recurring-profit normalization.

The longer uptrend remains intact while negative MACD histogram signals cooling momentum; consolidation above recent 2.53 support would be more constructive than another failed test of 2.65. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
